about: Round 35: vibrance only, its settings apart (when it starts, its strength, the paper), scripts/video/grade.js; round35.html has the curves.

drafts.name: Jungle Moon, tuned: vibrance, its three settings
drafts.source: Round 35: when it starts, how strong, what the paper does (round35.html has the curves)
drafts.line: Vibrance only. Each version is three numbers: the intensity where it starts, its strength (how much a muted colour gains), and what the paper does. The first moment plays from normal (0.48) into the intense part (0.79 at 40 s).
moments: Batidão 18 s: intense most of the song (0.82)

variants.label: From 0.2 · strength 1.1 · paper changes
variants.note: Round 33’s, as it was. Starts at intensity 0.2, rises in a straight line to full at 0.8: Circus’s normal verse (0.36) already gets a quarter of it.

variants.label: From 0.45 · strength 0.75 · paper changes
variants.note: Round 34’s C. Nothing below 0.45, full at 0.8, eased at both ends.

variants.label: From 0.45 · strength 0.75 · paper stays
variants.note: Round 34’s D: as C, but the paper and the pencilled course never change.

variants.label: From 0.45 · strength 1.1 · paper half
variants.note: Round 33’s strength with round 34’s start; the paper gains half as much as the rest.

variants.label: From 0.45 · strength 1.1 · paper stays
variants.note: Round 33’s strength with round 34’s start; the paper never changes.

variants.label: From 0.6 · strength 1.1 · paper half
variants.note: Only the most intense parts: nothing below 0.6, full at 0.85, eased; the paper half.

variants.label: From 0.6 · strength 1.1 · paper stays
variants.note: As the one before, the paper never changes.
